overview: This enum marks an attack combo as short range or long range for combat tracking.

None.simple: This combo has no range category.
None.technical: None is the constructor default for AttackSetDataTable.AttackRangeType. FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::Start reaches the range switch only after AttackRow resolves and StartCount is not positive. None matches no case and reaches the default branch, so it adds no battle log value and calls no range tracker.

Short.simple: Track this combo as a short-range attack.
Short.technical: On a successful AttackRow lookup with StartCount at most zero, Short adds battle log value 0x3F with count 1 and a weight of 1.0f, then calls OnCharacterShortRangeAttack with the owner control type and count 1. It does not change the attack animation or hit geometry.

Long.simple: Track this combo as a long-range attack.
Long.technical: On a successful AttackRow lookup with StartCount at most zero, Long adds battle log value 0x40 with count 1 and a weight of 1.0f, then calls OnCharacterLongRangeAttack with the owner control type and count 1. It does not change the attack animation or hit geometry.

Invalid.technical: Invalid is the 255 sentinel. It has no explicit switch case, so an assigned value would reach the default branch and add no range log value. No traced source caller or exported AttackSet row assigns Invalid.

notes: AttackRangeType is an AttackSetDataTable field rather than an AttackDataTable field.
The tracking branch runs only on the first attack start. A positive StartCount skips the range switch entirely.
Exported AttackSet rows use None, Short, and Long. No exported row uses Invalid.
